name: harness
description: Generator-evaluator loop inspired by Anthropic's Harness pattern. A planner creates the approach, a coder implements it, and a reviewer evaluates the result. The loop continues until the reviewer approves or the iteration limit is reached.

parameters.name: max_review_rounds
parameters.description: Maximum number of review iterations before the loop stops

parameters.name: termination_criteria
parameters.description: Criteria the reviewer uses to decide approval
parameters.default: The reviewer must explicitly approve the implementation as meeting the stated goal. Approval means no remaining issues that affect correctness or completeness.

roles.name: plan
roles.prompt: Analyze the goal, review any previous iteration feedback, and create or update the implementation plan. Focus on actionable steps the coder can follow. If this is a rework iteration, address the reviewer's specific concerns.

roles.name: implement
roles.prompt: Implement the plan from the previous stage. Follow the plan's steps precisely. Write clean, tested code. If reworking from a previous iteration, focus on the specific issues identified by the reviewer. After implementation, create an artifact using artifact_create with a summary of all changes made, then call artifact_stage(stage: "final") on it so the reviewer can verify your work.

roles.name: evaluate
roles.prompt: Review the implementation against the original goal and the plan. IMPORTANT: Use artifact_list with type: "loop_output" to find loop-specific artifacts rather than browsing all session artifacts (which may contain stale items from prior work). Then use artifact_get to read the full content of each relevant artifact — the inline summary may be truncated. Check for correctness, completeness, code quality, and edge cases. Use shell tools to verify actual file state. If the implementation meets the acceptance criteria, approve it. If not, provide specific, actionable feedback for the next iteration.
